query:
SELECT 
  tg.id, 
  tg.gene_name, 
  tg.product, 
  tg.subfamily,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tps_molecule_links WHERE tps_gene_id = tg.id) as existing_links
FROM tps_genes tg
WHERE tg.product IS NOT NULL AND tg.product != ''
ORDER BY tg.subfamily, tg.gene_name
LIMIT 50;
